title: Serbia's Aleksandar Vucic concedes defeat in parliament poll

blocks.text: BELGRADE — Serbia’s ruling party lost parliamentary snap elections, veteran leader Aleksandar Vucic said Sunday, citing preliminary results showing the student-backed protest movement surging ahead. “Based on a stratified sample, it is clear that we lost these elections,” Vucic told supporters at his party headquarters in Belgrade. The snap vote is the culmination of nearly two years of student-led protests after the 2024 collapse of a canopy at Novi Sad railway station that killed 16 people.
